snippet.title: Egging on - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: You are an egg. Wobble, roll and crack your way to freedom in Egging On. Escape the hen-house, navigate perilous levels filled with farms, factories and rooftops, and master the eggy physics of jumps and rolls before the shell gives out. With unique skins to unlock and hidden stamps to collect, this precision platformer from Egobounds will test your skill and patience. Wishlist it now!
